replies.author: RefrigeratorDry2669
replies.body:
I haven't used the design thing yet, I gave it a picture in the past and for one website I told it to create a WordPress theme and it worked in 1 shot. Some css alignment was lateron needed, when I changed things a bit - it aligned it pretty good - I gave it a slight tweak becease I can't stand it if it's even 1 pixel off but that was it. 

I can imagine it's even easier with the design thing. 

I used claude chat for the general plan and then tasked it with creating detailed plans for claude code after the project grew a bit. I also gave it access to the project github so it knew all the code and could create merge requests (I always work with a protected dev and main branch)

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body:
There are multiple versions of « it can be done as an actual UI », as this kind of style could be a lot of CSS work;

Cheap: just take most of the visuals as baked png, and build the small interactive parts like temperature numbers.

Moderate to hard, depending on your expectations: re-build the layout in CSS, AI might help, but will probably be quiet bad (if you’re not willing to lower your expectations).

Very hard: take it as a high-level mockup, and rebuild the whole UI by hand (with some AI speedup). This what would lead you to the closest functional UI as this screenshot.

So it really depends on expectations, do you aim for a working-ish rigid version, or a full-blown production UI.
